origin: Deferred from MT-007 post-implementation adversarial review (2026-07-29).

scope.summary: Harden the spawned-process reclaim reaper beyond the MT-007 crash->restart boot case: cover the running-app window and decide fail-open vs fail-closed on kill failure. MT-007's blocker (generic reclaim wired into boot) is closed and runtime-proven; these are secondary residuals surfaced by adversarial review, deferred so they are not forgotten.
scope.root_cause: The boot reclaimer only surfaces dead-prior-owner (crash->restart) orphans; the periodic staleness task restart pass is disabled post-boot, and its stale_sessions query vetoes rows lacking a model_lanes record, so a live-instance official-CLI (no-lane) orphan is reaped only at the NEXT boot.
forbidden_paths: weakening the pid + creation-time + exe-sha256 process identity fence
fabricating a STOP from unproven kill evidence
acceptance_criteria: F1 (MAJOR): a same-instance mid-run official-CLI (no model_lanes row) orphan whose process terminated/reap-failed is reaped by the RUNNING app (staleness task or a CLI-session-end reclaim trigger), not only at next boot; add a runtime proof.

F2 (MAJOR): decide+implement the intended post-boot staleness restart-pass semantics (currently run_restart_pass=false) so restart-orphans get periodic re-surfacing if the boot pass is skipped/times out, OR document why boot-only suffices.

F3 (design decision, operator): kill-failure at boot is currently fail-OPEN (row left OPEN, boot continues). Decide resilient-boot (fail-open + retry) vs hard fail-closed (boot Err on un-reapable orphan); implement+prove the chosen contract incl. the non-Windows unavailable-adapter path (KillOutcome::Failed + row stays open).

F4 (MINOR): HANDSHAKE_STARTUP_RECOVERY_ONLY=1 returns before production_with_lease so it never surfaces generic spawned-process orphans; run reconcile_restart_orphans_at_boot in that branch too, or document the exclusion.

F5 (MINOR): reclaim.rs docstring/comment overstate fail-closed (true only for store/surfacing errors); RestartOrphanBootReconcileReport.processes_reclaimed counts KillOutcome::Failed as reclaimed. Correct the doc and count only Killed|KilledPendingStop (add processes_kill_failed).

F6 (MINOR): fold the staleness task inline restart loop (reclaim.rs ~4314) into reconcile_restart_orphans_at_boot with a caller-chosen error policy to prevent drift, OR document the intentional divergence; boot call site silently drops in-progress-reconcile sweep errors (ReclaimKillOperationSweep.reclaim_error).

F7 (NIT): MT-007 boot proof uses ProductionSandboxKill::new (default registry) and bypasses the production_with_lease 30s timeout wrapper; add coverage exercising with_registry(production_process_sandbox_registry()) + timeout. free_loopback_udp_port has an ephemeral-port re-bind flake window; retry or skip.
scope.risk_if_missed: A live-app official-CLI orphan can stay OPEN until the next restart; an un-reapable orphan is silently left open with an overstated fail-closed claim.

implementation_notes: F1: reap at the hook, not by relaxing stale_sessions. Give GuardedCliChild an Option<Arc<Reclaim>> and call run_process(parent_session_id, process_uuid, ReclaimTrigger::Failure) from official_cli_bridge.rs leave_open_for_reconciliation. run_process uses active_process_for_session and bypasses the session-wide veto in stale_sessions. Existing in-repo precedent: api/palmistry.rs survivor cleanup and coordinator.rs teardown failure both already call run_process this way.

F1 DO NOT relax reclaim.rs stale_sessions None=>false to true: the row carries no liveness evidence and is owned by the LIVE instance, so that would kill healthy in-flight official-CLI children. A negative test must prove a live same-instance child is never killed.

F2: on the real boot path spawn_managed_staleness_reclaim_task_after_boot passes run_restart_pass=false, so restart_sessions runs exactly once inline in production_with_lease. A boot-pass TIMEOUT is already fail-closed (production_with_lease returns Err). The genuine gap is the SKIPPED case; add a periodic restart tick.

F3 OPERATOR DECISION 2026-07-30 = RESILIENT BOOT (fail-open + explicit surfacing + retry). Keep run_claimed returning Ok on KillOutcome::Failed. Make the fail-open explicit: count kill-failures separately, surface them out of boot (runtime.rs currently discards the whole report), and retry via F2. Do NOT make boot return Err: the native reclaim adapter is Windows-only and always returns Failed off-Windows, which would permanently brick boot; and fail-closed cannot distinguish a correct refusal-to-kill (pid-reuse guard) from a genuine reap failure.

F4: HANDSHAKE_STARTUP_RECOVERY_ONLY=1 returns in main.rs ~271 before production_with_lease (~447), so reconcile_restart_orphans_at_boot never runs and only reclaim_pidless_embedded_orphans executes. Any added pass must complete BEFORE managed_pg.stop() in that branch.

F5: reclaim.rs processes_reclaimed uses .len() over all ReclaimedProcess, counting Failed as reclaimed. Count only Killed|KilledPendingStop and add processes_kill_failed. The report has ZERO existing read sites (runtime.rs discards it), and derive(Default) means adding a field needs no other construction edit. Discrimination reference impl already exists in mt_executor/cancellation.rs TryFrom<ReclaimReport>.

F5: correct the doc overstatements - reclaim.rs RestartOrphanBootReconcileReport doc says fenced-closed (not a KillOutcome variant) and claims fail-closed error semantics; runtime.rs claims it reclaims every generic spawned-process orphan. Neither is true for kill failure.

F6: fold the staleness inline restart loop into reconcile_restart_orphans_at_boot with a caller-chosen error policy (abort vs log-and-continue) plus a cancellation hook - the same seam F3 needs. Also stop dropping ReclaimKillOperationSweep.reclaim_error at the boot call site.

F7: the MT-007 boot proof uses ProductionSandboxKill::new (default registry, HandshakeNative only) and calls reconcile_restart_orphans_at_boot directly, bypassing production_with_lease and its 30s timeout. production_process_sandbox_registry() and with_registry have ZERO occurrences under tests/. Add coverage using the production registry plus the timeout wrapper. Also retry free_loopback_udp_port: the drop-then-probe window lets another host process take the ephemeral port and silently veto surfacing.

HBR-MAN-004 landing spot: user_manual/seed.rs section(recovery, Hard-crash orphan reconcile) currently says nothing about restart_sessions, reconcile_restart_orphans_at_boot, the fail-open kill-failure contract, or the recovery-only exclusion. The behavior-coverage gate assertions are contains-based, so added text is safe.
NO MIGRATION REQUIRED: processes_kill_failed is an in-memory struct field; nothing in F1-F7 changes a table.

handshake_compatibility.spec_realism_gate: Every F1-F7 proof must exercise the real reclaim runtime against Handshake-managed PostgreSQL with a real spawned child process. Mock adapters and fixture-only assertions cannot satisfy F1, F3, or F7.

operator_decisions.question: When boot cannot reap a spawned-process orphan (kill fails), should boot fail open or fail closed?
operator_decisions.rationale: The Failed path is already truthful and idempotently retryable (claim released, fence cleared, no false STOP). Fail-closed would permanently brick boot off-Windows because the native reclaim adapter is Windows-only and always returns Failed, and it cannot distinguish a correct refusal-to-kill from a genuine reap failure.
